issues.description: The source subtitle is a single line with clear separation below the title, but the render wraps the final character onto a second line and crowds the title area, materially breaking the title/subtitle hierarchy.

Corner radii are systematically mismatched: all three rendered cards are much more rounded than the source cards, while the rendered footer is much squarer than the source's fully pill-shaped bar. This changes the slide's dominant shape language.
The source background has a subtle light-to-blue-gray vertical tonal transition, whereas the render uses a nearly uniform flat gray-blue field, reducing the source's gentle depth cue.
The source shows a larger decorative ellipse cropped more strongly by the top and right edges; the render presents a smaller, more fully visible ellipse, changing the upper-right balance.

changes.position: shift upward and right to match source crop

background_seams.rationale: No hard rectangular crop seam or discontinuous decorative join is visible in the render.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source has no arrows or semantic connector endpoints to compare.

connector_topology.rationale: The source contains no semantic connectors, branches, merges, or process loop; the three horizontal rules are decorative dividers only.

crop_boundaries.rationale: The source contains no raster artwork or cropped media assets, and the asset manifest is empty.

key_proportions.rationale: The three-card scale, card spacing, footer footprint, and overall primary-object balance closely match the source.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The subtitle wraps to two lines and crowds the title instead of preserving the source's clean single-line secondary hierarchy.

visual_depth.rationale: The rendered page flattens the source's subtle background tonal transition.
